question: If P : 14 :: 57 : 21, then find the value of P.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any proportion, the product of the extremes equals the product of the means.

P × 21 = 14 × 57

P = (14 × 57) ÷ 21

P = 2 × 19 = 38

**∴ The correct answer is 38.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The proportion is P : 14 :: 57 : 21.

**Formula Used:**

If a : b :: c : d, then a ÷ b = c ÷ d

**Calculations:**

⇒ P ÷ 14 = 57 ÷ 21

⇒ P = (57 × 14) ÷ 21

⇒ P = (19 × 3 × 14) ÷ (7 × 3)

⇒ P = (19 × 14) ÷ 7

⇒ P = 19 × 2

⇒ P = 38

**∴ The correct answer is 38.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Proportion Definition

When two ratios are equivalent, they are said to be in proportion. It is represented as a : b :: c : d or expressed as a ÷ b = c ÷ d.

Means and Extremes Property

In any proportion a : b :: c : d, the product of the extreme terms equals the product of the mean terms (a × d = b × c).

Continued Proportion

If three quantities a, b, and c are in continued proportion, then a : b :: b : c, which results in the relation b² = a × c.
